text:
laura (support): Customer on hosted inference (tenant: acme-corp) reports a spike of 502/504s starting ~10:45 UTC. They say requests are timing out for bursts and a few customers hit 30s+ latencies. Escalating to eng-sre.
aj (eng-sre): saw alerts: gateway 5xx spike + scale-up queue backlog. Symptoms look like pods not becoming Ready quickly -> requests pile up -> gateway timeouts.
laura (support): customer timeline: 10:42 lots of traffic, 10:44 first errors, 10:46 full fail. They provided sample request id: req_38b2.
sanjay (eng-runtime): adding logs from router / kube events: "Failed to pull metrics for ScaledObject: 404 target not found" then HPA show minReplicas=0 for that tenant. Could be ScaledObject annotation mismatch.
maria (oncall): tagging KEDA team. Quick question: is model init heavy for acme-corp model? They've pinned a large 70B variant in hosted pool.
sanjay (eng-runtime): yes model is a large 70B ggml variant we're serving via multi-tenant pool. Cold init time typically ~22-30s on that node type; but we rely on prewarm/KV cache to avoid full init. If HPA doesn't kick to keep minReplicas>0, coldstarts happen.
aj (eng-sre): A quick mitigation while we triage: route acme-corp to dedicated warm pool or increase minReplicas for that tenant. I'll try a temporary force-scale to 2 pods.
laura (support): customer asked for root cause and ETA. Please advise ASAP.
opsbot: Incident created INC-2026-4571 by aj. Pager notified oncall.
aj (eng-sre): reproducer steps I ran: flood 200 concurrent requests -> KEDA ScaledObject didn't eval because scaleTargetRef name mismatched (scaledobject pointed to svc: inference-pool-v1 but deployment renamed to inference-pool-main). That causes no metrics -> HPA stays at 0 -> coldstart queue.
sanjay (eng-runtime): sharing ScaledObject snippet: ```yaml
apiVersion: keda.sh/v1alpha1
kind: ScaledObject
metadata:
  name: acme-inference-scaledobject
spec:
  scaleTargetRef:
    apiVersion: apps/v1
    kind: Deployment
    name: inference-pool-v1  # expected name mismatch
  pollingInterval: 30
  cooldownPeriod: 300
```
aj (eng-sre): that name mismatch plus pollingInterval=30s means it takes up to >30s to react. Combined with deployment readinessProbe initialDelaySeconds=20 and model init ~25s -> effective scale-up window ~80s. Gateway times out earlier.
maria (oncall): confirmed kube events show "no matching scale target" and HPA remains at 0 for that deployment.
laura (support): customer also reported auth errors intermittently 403 earlier in the window. Could that be related?
sanjay (eng-runtime): 403s look like short-lived token refresh failures from our billing/auth service during the surge; some requests retried and hit the queue, amplifying load. Not the root cause but contributed to headroom exhaustion.
aj (eng-sre): actions: 1) fix ScaledObject name to inference-pool-main (hotfix) 2) reduce pollingInterval to 5s for bursty tenants 3) set minReplica for that tenant to 1-2 while we observe 4) tweak readinessProbe initialDelaySeconds -> 5s and increase failureThreshold to avoid flapping during init.
laura (support): please confirm rollback plan and customer message. They want ETA 30m.
aj (eng-sre): doing hotfix now, applying patch to ScaledObject + setting minReplicas=1. Will monitor.
opsbot: Patch applied by aj at 1777733380. CI job: patch-apply-892 succeeded.
aj (eng-sre): temporary mitigation in place. Traffic routed, early signs: queue drained, errors dropped to baseline. Still monitoring for any regressions.
sanjay (eng-runtime): for long-term: recommend two changes: prewarm policy for tenants with pinned large models, and add integration test that verifies ScaledObject.scaleTargetRef matches deployment name on deploy. Also add improved alert that detects "scaledobject no target" faster.
maria (oncall): will open a follow-up ticket to track baking those changes (SRE-873).
laura (support): I sent a note to the customer: "We identified an autoscaling config mismatch plus readiness delays; applied a hotfix and temporary min replicas. We expect traffic to normalize; follow-up postmortem within 48h." They acknowledged. :thumbsup:
aj (eng-sre): next steps: postmortem, include repro steps, patch to operator that validates scaledobject on creation, and consider lowering KEDA polling interval for hosted inference default.
sanjay (eng-runtime): also will instrument model-init latency in per-tenant metrics so SLOs can alert before gateway errors.
laura (support): closing the live escalation, keeping ticket open until postmortem. thanks everyone.
aj (eng-sre): thank you — will draft postmortem and link incidents ticket.
opsbot: Incident INC-2026-4571 updated: status=mitigated at 1777733505."
